## Fixes
- **Clear socket-proxy errors** – when a docker-socket-proxy refuses a request it answers with a bare *403 Forbidden – Request forbidden by administrative rules*. ArrHub now says exactly which request was refused and which switch to turn on, e.g. *refused GET /containers/json – set CONTAINERS=1 on the socket-proxy container*, *… POST /containers/radarr/stop – set CONTAINERS=1 + ALLOW_STOP=1*, *… POST /images/create – set IMAGES=1 + POST=1*. Error pages from the proxy are no longer shown as raw HTML.

## Upgrade

**Docker**
```bash
docker pull ghcr.io/moordrak/arrhub:1.15.1   # or :latest
docker compose up -d                           # if you use docker-compose.yml
```

**Proxmox LXC** (on the Proxmox host)
```bash
pct exec <CTID> -- bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/moordrak/arrhub/main/install.sh)"
```

**Debian / Ubuntu**
```bash
bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/moordrak/arrhub/main/install.sh)"
```

Your existing `config.json` is kept.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/moordrak/arrhub/compare/v1.15.0...v1.15.1
